entries.title: 1. The Pattern Interrupt (Video/Social)
entries.base_prompt: [Visual Hook: Sudden change in scale, color, or motion] + [Text Overlay: Controversial or curiosity-inducing question] + [Audio Trigger: High-energy sync point] + [Pacing: Fast-cut transition to reveal]

entries.title: 2. The Personalization Engine (Interactive)
entries.base_prompt: [Input Type: e.g., User's photo/voice note] + [Transformation Protocol: How the AI alters the input to fit brand aesthetic] + [Output Goal: A shareable, high-status version of the user's input] + [Call to Action (CTA): "Upload yours now"]

entries.title: 3. The "Citation Bait" (Text/SEO)
entries.base_prompt: [Core Insight: A unique, data-backed perspective on [Topic]] + [Structure: Clear headings, bulleted lists, and authoritative tone] + [Context: Relatable real-world examples that provide "human" nuance]

metadata.use_case: Creating content designed to be picked up by AI Search Summaries (GEO).
